# Replica Crew

> One repo for cloning apps and websites with Claude Code and Codex: an orchestrator, 11 specialist subagents (Claude .md and Codex .toml) that clone an app's features end to end, 15 bundled clone/design/UI-to-code skills, and a map of 70+ tools (recon, architect, design, entrepreneur, build, backend, test, diff, brand, launch, deploy). Clean-room: features and flows, never code, brand or content. MIT. Built on the Replica skill pack by Jake Schincariol.

Install: `/plugin marketplace add damiantorresmx11/replica-crew` then `/plugin install replica-crew@replica-crew`. Run: `/replica-crew <app url>` (Claude) or `$replica-crew <app url>` (Codex). Install for both: `python scripts/install.py`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/damiantorresmx11/replica-crew/blob/main/README.md): overview, waves, install
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/damiantorresmx11/replica-crew/blob/main/AGENTS.md): use with Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI
- [Orchestrator](https://github.com/damiantorresmx11/replica-crew/blob/main/skills/replica-crew/SKILL.md): waves, parallel phases, quality loop
- [Ecosystem](https://github.com/damiantorresmx11/replica-crew/blob/main/docs/ECOSYSTEM.md): 70+ open-source AI app-cloning tools by phase

## Skills

- [replica-recon](https://github.com/damiantorresmx11/replica-crew/blob/main/skills/replica-recon/SKILL.md): screens, flows, data model, feature matrix
- [replica-architect](https://github.com/damiantorresmx11/replica-crew/blob/main/skills/replica-architect/SKILL.md): stack, SQL schema, API
- [replica-design](https://github.com/damiantorresmx11/replica-crew/blob/main/skills/replica-design/SKILL.md): design tokens, WCAG contrast
- [replica-entrepreneur](https://github.com/damiantorresmx11/replica-crew/blob/main/skills/replica-entrepreneur/SKILL.md): review mining, fix plan, positioning
- [replica-build](https://github.com/damiantorresmx11/replica-crew/blob/main/skills/replica-build/SKILL.md): screen-by-screen rebuild
- [replica-backend](https://github.com/damiantorresmx11/replica-crew/blob/main/skills/replica-backend/SKILL.md): auth, DB, Stripe, email
- [replica-test](https://github.com/damiantorresmx11/replica-crew/blob/main/skills/replica-test/SKILL.md): Playwright, bug log
- [replica-diff](https://github.com/damiantorresmx11/replica-crew/blob/main/skills/replica-diff/SKILL.md): parity score, layout diff
- [replica-brand](https://github.com/damiantorresmx11/replica-crew/blob/main/skills/replica-brand/SKILL.md): rename, palette, leftover sweep
- [replica-launch](https://github.com/damiantorresmx11/replica-crew/blob/main/skills/replica-launch/SKILL.md): landing, pricing, store listing
- [replica-deploy](https://github.com/damiantorresmx11/replica-crew/blob/main/skills/replica-deploy/SKILL.md): preflight, DNS, production
- [Third-party notices](https://github.com/damiantorresmx11/replica-crew/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md): 15 bundled skills (clone-team, clone-website, web-clone, clone-study, design-mirror, Stitch skills, video-to-ui, ui-image-to-code, restyle, app-store-screenshots)
